shortcut_name: recognition of Johnson's two-machine flow shop
evidence: deepseek: "group_a.append" for p1 <= p2 and "group_b.sort ... descending rendering time"; gpt-oss: "front ... a <= b" and "back ... a > b" with the same sorting
affordance_in_statement: A studio processes j assets through exactly two stages: drafting and rendering. ... You may choose the order in which the assets are processed (both stages process the assets in the same chosen order).
removal_suggestion: There is no semantics-preserving removal: the two-stage, fixed-order structure is the core task. It can only be re-presented indirectly, for example as a FIFO drafting queue feeding a non-overtaking rendering queue, without naming the two-machine flow-shop structure.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Recognizes Johnson's rule and partitions assets by whether drafting or rendering is shorter.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: Every asset passes through exactly two serial stages, and both stages use the same selected order.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Recognizes the same Johnson partition into a <= b and a > b groups, then sorts each group in the standard order.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: Every asset must complete drafting before rendering, with both stages processing assets in the same chosen order.

common_affordance: The intrinsic two-stage flow-shop structure with one common job order, which directly enables Johnson's rule.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: It sorts all assets by drafting duration ascending, which ignores Johnson's partition and can place long-rendering assets incorrectly.
It first sorts by min(p1,p2) and then partitions, so the resulting groups do not necessarily have drafting times ascending in the first group or rendering times descending in the second group.

recommended_edit: No edit can defeat all survivors while preserving the task: removing or changing the common-order two-stage structure changes the optimization problem. If only presentation may change, replace the explicit flow-shop wording with an indirect FIFO/non-overtaking pipeline scenario.
